rows.doc: A fact this heavy or heavier joins its tile's event ring.
Units of each material a tile's node holds before it is worked out; what is gathered decays back by the gathered counter.
Locked pouches a character may carry; with this many, a find comes loose as it always did.
Falls across a dungeon's floors inside haunted-days that make it haunted.
How far back the falls that haunt a dungeon are counted.
The chance a floor gives back something lost on it.
